review_description: I paid $34,000 for a YOU BEAUTY SYSTEM that was going to save me all this money. I was and still am a invalid pensioner. The system was 39 solar panels on the roof which still leaks, 2 inverters which dont work and 1 large battery which has never even been connected. The installer walked away not even finishing it.Nobody would even come out to inspect the job from the company. Ive had electricians look at it and have no idea what they are looking at. They still contact me and taunt me about parts being on the way to fix it and the job was supposed to be done in Feb 2022. Nothing again. Im still waiting for it to be fixed and working but i know its not going to be done. Ive asked for my money back to no avail. Fair trading didnt help so they are hopeless as well. Im trying to find a barrister now or take civil action.Please do not be fooled by this company. They will  rip all your money off of you then rub it in your face for years after that.
